note: داری is a noun/suffix element meaning possession/holding or a state/practice, especially in compounds. 'Content word' is not a POS.
ذکر in standard Urdu means mention/remembrance/reference. The anatomical gloss comes from a different Arabic vocalization/lexical reading and is not appropriate for this Urdu learner entry.
جائزہ means review/assessment/survey/inspection/examination. 'Present, prize' is erroneous source contamination.
کن is the plural/oblique interrogative form 'which/whom'. 'Closed-class' is too vague.
اصل centrally means origin/root/basis and also real/original/genuine. 'Fact; stock; bottom' is an unhelpful and partly noisy definition.
proposed_english: origin; root; basis; original; real; genuine

note: صاف means clean/clear/pure/plain. The source omits the extremely common 'clear' meaning.
زور centrally means force/strength/power/emphasis; adverbial forcibly can derive from constructions. 'Violence; violently' alone misrepresents the noun.
ادب means literature as well as manners/courtesy/respect. Omitting 'literature' is a major learner defect.
کالا centrally means black/dark. The source omits 'black' and foregrounds figurative evil/dirty senses.
یقین is a noun meaning certainty/belief/conviction/confidence. Adjective POS is incorrect.
روڈ is the English loan noun 'road'. 'Content word' is not a POS.
امید means hope/expectation. Pregnancy occurs idiomatically in امید سے 'pregnant' rather than as the standalone core noun meaning; name POS is not needed for the general entry.
proposed_english: hope; expectation; امید سے = pregnant (idiomatic construction)

note: Central selection/choice senses omitted.
تیز centrally means fast/quick as well as sharp/intense/strong/spicy. Omitting 'fast' is a basic learner error.
proposed_english: fast; quick; sharp; intense; strong; spicy/hot

note: دودھ means milk. Coconut liquid may be called coconut milk in context, but 'a woman's breast/nipple' is not a standard standalone meaning and should be removed.
موسم centrally means weather and season; climate is also valid. The source omits 'weather' and leads with generic 'time'.
نماز means ritual prayer/salat/prayer. 'Idolization' is misleading and inappropriate for the standard Urdu meaning.
Common imagination/mental-image sense omitted.
چنانچہ is a conjunctive adverb/discourse connector meaning therefore/consequently/accordingly. 'Closed-class' is too vague.
معیار centrally means standard/quality/criterion/measure/benchmark. 'Style, way' is peripheral and can confuse a learner.
عظیم means great/grand/magnificent/vast. It can occur in the divine epithet العظیم, but labeling the ordinary adjective itself as a 'name' is misleading.
proposed_english: great; grand; magnificent; vast; عظیم in the divine epithet العظیم (context-dependent)
